graph.name: Mobilewalla: S3 Access Monitoring Using ML
graph.notes:
Proactive, near real-time monitoring of S3 for suspicious activity.
    18-20M access log records/month.
    One comment proposes to use Amazon GuardDuty, the solution architect comments that 1) ElasticSearch is more flexible on the right attributes to monitor, 2) future extensibility for other types of logs, 3) GuardDuty was not available when this system was built.
